from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party named in the document."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the party")
    role: str | None = Field(description="The role of the party (e.g., 上诉人，被上诉人，申请人)")

class Court(BaseModel):
    """A court mentioned in the document."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the court")
    level: str | None = Field(description="The level of the court if identifiable (e.g., 中级，高级)")

class CaseIdentifier(BaseModel):
    """A case number or identifier mentioned in the document."""
    number: str | None = Field(description="The full case number string")
    context: str | None = Field(description="Context indicating the stage or type (e.g., 执行异议，二审)")

class CostItem(BaseModel):
    """A cost or fee item mentioned in the document."""
    type: str | None = Field(description="The type of cost (e.g., 一审受理费，二审案件受理费)")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The amount of the cost, if specified as a number")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="The party bearing the cost")
    allocation: str | None = Field(description="Specific allocation details if split among multiple parties")

class RulingDetail(BaseModel):
    """A specific ruling, decision, or penalty mentioned in the document."""
    action: str | None = Field(description="The court's action (e.g., 驳回上诉，维持原判，撤销原判)")
    specific_value: str | None = Field(description="Specific value determined (e.g., prison term, compensation amount)")
    description: str | None = Field(description="Short description of the ruling outcome")

class ProcedureType(BaseModel):
    """The procedural context of the document."""
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="Category of case (e.g., 民事，刑事，行政)")
    procedure_stage: str | None = Field(description="Stage of procedure (e.g., 二审，执行复议，再审)")
    finality_statement: str | None = Field(description="Statement on finality (e.g., 终审判决，终审裁定)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Parsed information from a single legal judgment document."""
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="All parties named in the document")
    courts: list[Court] = Field(description="All courts mentioned in the document")
    case_identifiers: list[CaseIdentifier] = Field(description="All case numbers or identifiers mentioned")
    costs: list[CostItem] = Field(description="All cost items and bearers identified")
    rulings: list[RulingDetail] = Field(description="All specific rulings or outcomes identified")
    procedure_contexts: list[ProcedureType] = Field(description="Procedural context and classification identified")
